title: CHA Basic Steps for Beginners / Latin Dance

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains concepts clearly while demonstrating with a partner in a studio setting. He breaks down steps into counts and demonstrates rhythm before combining movements into a routine.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Cha Cha basic steps
Breaking down cha cha time step (chasse and 2 steps in place)
Cha basic with rock step instead of closing
Explanation of hold options (double hold or closed hold)
First cha cha routine combining basic steps, check, spot turn and underarm turn

steps_taught.name: Cha Time Step
steps_taught.description: Chasse followed by two steps in place

what_works: Clear verbal breakdown of counts and footwork
what_hinders: Partner demonstrations can obscure foot placement from certain angles

quotes.text: We will start with basic in place.
How do we count in cha-cha-cha?
Now we will do basic, that means instead of closing we will do small rock step.
Now about hold, we can take double hold here low.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands in front of a plain background talking to the camera
Instructor and partner demonstrate the cha time step side by side on a wooden floor

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the count so that '4 and 1' are grouped together as the chasse and '2, 3' are grouped as the steps in place.
